source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/protocol/src/openai_models.rs (ModelsResponse, ModelInfo) + https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/models-manager/models.json (bundled model catalog) + codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs (CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL + the client_version query)
notes: The ChatGPT backend's model catalog: GET {chatgpt_base}/codex/models?client_version=<codex-cli-semver>, body ModelsResponse {"models":[ModelInfo]}. client_version is appended by codex-rs's ModelsClient on every request and is REQUIRED upstream — omitting it is a 400, and a stale/unknown value makes the backend silently filter the catalog to nothing, which is why an empty catalog is treated as a skip rather than as 'upstream dropped every model'. ModelInfo.slug is the wire model identifier. Capability fields the sync parses: context_window (fallback max_context_window) -> context length; supported_reasoning_levels -> thinking; input_modalities -> vision (omitted means text+image per codex-rs default_input_modalities; explicit [] means text only); supported_in_api plus shell_type != disabled, supports_search_tool, experimental_supported_tools, or tool_mode -> tools. web_search/web_fetch/code_execution remain account/fallback facts, not per-model facts. The models are current entries transcribed from the bundled catalog; the endpoint itself requires a signed-in ChatGPT account token.
